messages:
Jia L: kicking off migration add_nonnull_col on customers. DeployBot started canary 2/5 shards. scheduling quiet window 03:00 UTC and pinging ops for handoff.

DeployBot: Migration job 36792 started. Canary shards: shard-7, shard-12. Holdpoint queued at pre_apply. ETA ~8m.

Sam H: :eyes: noted. what's the rollback criteria?

Jia L: if pre_apply fails or row-lock time > 5s on >1 replica for 3m => abort. also abort if customers API error rate >2% during apply. on abort we'll tag rollback v2.11.3 in release notes.

Alex R: copy. i'll pin service proto to schema-v2.11.3 in the console so clients don't see partial changes. @DeployBot can you pin that tag?

DeployBot: DeployBot: Pinned schema tag schema-v2.11.3 for customers-service.

Priya O: i'll be oncall for the window. if we need to abort use:
```bash
./scripts/mig_abort 36792
```
and page SRE. standing by.

Michael B: adding quick smoke: `curl -sS https://staging-api/internal/customers/health` to verify after canary.

Jia L: release notes link added: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/3582. note documents non-null constraint and backfill window.

Sam H: if we hit long locks can we switch to non-blocking CTAS fallback? that was in the design doc.

Jia L: yes fallback is ready but manual. primary attempt first; if hold > 15m we switch to CTAS fallback. manual trigger: `RELEASE=ctas-fallback scripts/mig_fallback 36792`

Priya O: :thumbsup: noted. i'll escalate to db team if we observe >=2 min of >10s exclusive locks.

Alex R: heads-up to product — partial schema may show in telemetry, will note in relnotes.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Holdpoint reached (pre_apply). Pausing for manual confirmation. use `deploybot continue 36792` to proceed or `deploybot abort 36792` to stop.

Jia L: proceeding with canary apply on shard-7 now.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Canary apply succeeded on shard-7. moving to shard-12 in 30s.

Michael B: smoke passed for shard-7. cpu spike ~10% but stable. :tada: 

Sam H: if shard-12 fails we abort and start fallback, agree?

Jia L: yes. on abort i'll document reason in release notes and open follow-up task.

Priya O: if abort happens, who owns the follow-up? @Alex R?

Alex R: i'll own it — will open ticket and coordinate with db team.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Canary apply failed on shard-12: detected long-lived exclusive lock >30s. marking migration as paused. awaiting manual action.

Jia L: :warning: aborting primary path. initiating CTAS fallback now. Priya please run abort script to unblock clients.

Priya O: running abort now:
```bash
./scripts/mig_abort 36792 --force
```

DeployBot: DeployBot: Abort acknowledged. migration job 36792 status: aborted. trigger reason: long lock on shard-12. logs: https://logs.redwood/36792

Michael B: started CTAS fallback orchestration. ETA ~45m. i'll post updates in #eng-releases.

Sam H: thanks team. capture timestamps for postmortem — add timings to release notes and tag blockers.
